positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as the founding engineer and mobile tech lead for LinkedIn's first GenAI product, guiding an 8-engineer team from hackathon prototype to production launch.  
• Led LinkedIn’s Sharebox migration to Server-Driven UI, doubling feature development velocity through hot releases, a unified codebase, and reduced technical debt.
• Developed the Detour and Post Next Best Action framework, establishing reusable patterns adopted by multiple teams, improving collaboration and efficiency.
• Engineered end-to-end features across client and backend systems, delivering article entity embedding, collaborative post, scheduled post, sharebox enhancement, and customization notifications, etc. Architected and implemented on both client and backend.
• Adopter of agentic engineering tools within the organization. Built Claude Code-assisted workflows for unfamiliar-codebase exploration, prototyping, documentation, debugging, and repetitive engineering tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Objective-C · iOS development · Swift · React Native · Android · Java · REST APIs · Kotlin · Spring Framework · Software Design · GraphQL · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM)

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer
positions.description:
• Transitioned the iOS application architecture from MVC to MVVM for improved modularity.  
• Developed Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack, ensuring high-quality production releases.  
• Utilized modern application architecture and coroutines to optimize overall application performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained production iOS features for VoIP calling and group messaging.  
• Integrated various SDKs, REST APIs, and local caching into a large-scale mobile application.  
• Led the migration of key application components from Objective-C to Swift, ensuring backward compatibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained production iOS features for VoIP calling and group messaging.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of features.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed Objective-C iOS applications for major grocery retailers, enhancing consumer engagement through features like QR-code scanning and push notifications.  
• Integrated mobile applications with retailer services and backend APIs to support personalized offers and improve in-store customer experiences.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated on the development of an iOS app and backend system for a smart parking project.  
• Implemented machine learning algorithms and camera detection technologies to enhance parking efficiency.
